votes.motion: To approve the August 12, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting minutes as presented

To approve application # CUP2021-000329 requesting a Conditional Use Permit for an Office/ Warehouse with staff recommendation and a condition of no less than twenty-five parking stalls or ordinance minimum

To recommend approval for application #EXP2021-000344 requesting an exception from roadway improvements (curb, gutter, and sidewalk) to the Magna Mayor with Salt Lake County Engineering recommendations of improvements of gravel and grading right-of-way improvements up to ten years

To recommend approval of application #REZ2021-000383 requesting approval to rezone property from the R-1-6 (Single-Family residential) zone to the R-1-5 (Single-Family residential) zone to the Magna Metro Township Council with Staff Recommendations

To recommend approval of file #OAM2021-000273 on a proposed ordinance creating Chapter 19.15 of the Magna Municipal Code allowing for and regulating Interior Accessory Dwelling Units (IADUs) in single-family detached dwellings to the Magna Metro Township Council with changes to 19.15.040 to limit the number of residents to four persons or two adults and dependents, and 19.15.100 to limit one IADU or ADU
